messages:
Lila (Sales): Heads-up: HelixSecure POC next week. They need SSO via SAML, SCIM for a one-time bulk import (~50k users) plus incremental syncs, RBAC sync for groups, and domain ownership verification. Two potential blockers: contractor NameIDs come from a proxy with a different persistent format, and they want SCIM 'replace' semantics during daily sync windows (peak ~400 req/s). Also asking for Hosted vs Dedicated pricing guidance. Tagging SE + Security. @Rach @Samir

Rach (SE): Quick clarifying q: is the proxy emitting a different NameID with the same issuer or is it a separate issuer? If same issuer we can apply claim transforms and canonicalize. If separate issuer we'll need alias mappings (issuer+subject -> primary user).

Priya (Prospect): It's the same Azure AD tenant but contractors route through a lightweight proxy that rewrites the NameID to an email-like token. We can try to normalize but want Redwood to tolerate both forms. We'll hand over a sample CSV and metadata.

Marco (Eng): Implementation notes: we have an alias table for (idp_issuer, nameid) -> user_id to support multi-format assertions. For SCIM heavy imports we recommend staged ingest via our bulk-import endpoint, which accepts CSV/JSON and applies idempotent upserts into a staging queue. For live syncs prefer PATCH with pagination (500/page) rather than full PUT replace for 50k users. Example throttle pattern we use: token bucket per-tenant + short backoff on 429s.

Samir (Security): Security callouts: SCIM bearer tokens must support rotation; we'll need to verify their proxy rotation cadence. If they request BYO-KMS, HSM-backed keys, or isolated audit streams that will push towards Private deployment. Hosted can support AES-256 at rest and KMS integrations (AWS/GCP) but not HSM by default. Also need to confirm domain verification approach for tenant-scoped RBAC claims.

Lila (Sales): Can SE give a ballpark Dedicated commit for sustained peak of ~400 rps during a 10m window and daily 50k churn so we can scope pricing and the account exec can prepare terms?

Rach (SE): Ballpark: Dedicated reserved pool (S-class) with burst capacity. Expect low to mid five-figures USD/month committed depending on log retention and SLA. If they need BYO-KMS/HSM or segregated logs, add Private uplift. I'll confirm exact tiers with pricing-ops and paste link here.

Priya (Prospect): For RBAC we need group sync semantics: map SCIM group membership -> internal roles and preserve historical role grants for audit. Also require the ability to mark a domain as owned so email claims are authoritative.

Marco (Eng): On RBAC mapping: we support group-to-role mapping via config and persist grant audit events. We can replay a bulk replace as a delta job (compute differences server-side) to avoid transient account churn. We'll also add a short cooldown on alias writes to avoid DB hotspots during the initial import.

Samir (Security): I'll draft answers for the security questionnaire: encryption at rest, KMS integrations, audit retention options, token rotation, SCIM auth patterns, and RBAC audit trails. If they ask for HSM or dedicated audit endpoints we'll note Private as recommended.

infra-bot: ticket POC-9001 created: "HelixSecure SCIM bulk + NameID aliasing + RBAC mapping" assigned to eng-platform.

Lila (Sales): Scheduling a 30m technical sync Wed 11am PT with Priya, Rach, Marco, Samir. Priya please upload sample CSV + Azure metadata before the call. I'll attach the security questionnaire so Samir can prefill.

Priya (Prospect): Will upload CSV and metadata by EOD. One more pricing q: if we go Dedicated, can we start with a 3-month commit for the POC and then scale to annual if successful?

Rach (SE): Yes, we have short-term Reserved offers for POCs in many cases; pricing-ops will confirm minimums. I'll post the confirmed pricing buckets once I hear back.

Lila (Sales): Great 44d Closing thread for now; will reopen after pricing-ops reply and after we schedule the sync.
